lee_ir: Heads up - acme-fin wants an evidence bundle showing which KMS keys were used for their tenant, plus a verifiable chain-of-custody for a specific 14-day window. What's the lightweight playbook we can run and hand them?
sandra_devops: short flow I use: 1) export KMS audit events (CloudTrail / Cloud Logging) for the tenant label, 2) normalize to ndjson, 3) compress, 4) compute sha256, 5) sign with evidence key, 6) create SLE ticket + attach. can paste example commands.
morgan_az: please paste the commands and also include how we map service accounts to tenant IDs (they keep asking).
sandra_devops: example (GCP):
```
# export KMS-related logs for TENANT-456
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND labels.tenant_id="TENANT-456" AND timestamp>="2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"' --format=json > tenant456.kms.ndjson
jq -c . tenant456.kms.ndjson | gzip > tenant456.kms.ndjson.gz
sha256sum tenant456.kms.ndjson.gz > tenant456.kms.sha256
gpg --local-user evidence@redwood --output tenant456.kms.sig --armor --detach-sign tenant456.kms.sha256
```
(AWS variant: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --start-time ... --end-time ... -> normalize -> gzip -> sha256 -> sign)
lee_ir: good. for mapping: request router attaches x-tenant-id header which is written into log.labels.tenant_id at ingress. mapping table is tenant_registry.tenant_id -> service_account_email. we can export tenant_registry snapshot as CSV and include it in the packet.
morgan_az: legal question: can we include service account emails (they are customer managed in some cases)? legal_jame, any constraints?
legal_jame: if the service account is owned by the customer (meaning it lives under their tenant) we can share. If it's a Redwood-managed internal service account, redact or provide truncated hash. We need DPA clause as well; please route the packet through privacy review before sending.
oncall_tess: created ticket SLE-EVID-9921 to track this evidence request and retention. I'm pinning artifacts to secure-bucket://evidence/acme-fin/99321/. Approver: @lee_ir.
ir-bot: REMINDER: Incident evidence checklist requires (a) artifact hash, (b) signer identity, (c) approver ticket ID, (d) export query used.
sandra_devops: adding vuln note here: CVE-2025-9999 hit an old KMS client in some edge deployments; runtime-2.2.1 has the backport. I'll attach release note snippet and git tag.
morgan_az: add RBAC diff too — we scoped svc-acct to kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt and removed broader iam roles. Which PR?
sandra_devops: PR #4620 removed iam:ServiceAccountTokenCreator from tenant role and added cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter binding. excerpt of audit log below (sanitized):
```
2026-09-03T14:02:11Z iam.change principal: serviceAccount:svc-acme-456@redwood action: add binding roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
2026-09-03T14:02:12Z iam.change principal: serviceAccount:svc-acme-456@redwood action: remove binding roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
lee_ir: ok. also prepare a short paragraph explaining how we can show a negative (i.e., how to prove a model request did NOT read plaintext customer PII) — e.g., show KV-cache keys (prefix tenant-456/kv/*), cache hit logs, and denylist scan logs. include the sample query to search logs for pii labels.
morgan_az: sample negative query?
sandra_devops:
```
# search for any log entries that flagged pii=true in tenant scope
gcloud logging read 'labels.tenant_id="TENANT-456" AND jsonPayload.labels.pii=true' --limit=10
```
legal_jame: please also include a statement that we do not export decryption keys or plaintext; we only show metadata (key IDs, timestamps, principals). Any plaintext exposure must be escalated with explicit signed consent.
oncall_tess: uploaded a test bundle to secure-bucket://evidence/acme-fin/99321/tenant456-kms-20260901-0900.gz, sha256: a1f9b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd, sig: tenant456-kms.sig (signed by evidence@redwood). ticket SLE-EVID-9921 updated.
morgan_az: great. I'll draft the SQ response using: 1) export + sha256 + sig, 2) tenant_registry snapshot CSV, 3) RBAC PR link + diff, 4) runtime patch evidence for CVE-2025-9999, 5) negative-access guidance paragraph, 6) legal approval note.
lee_ir: I'll review tonight and ACK in the ticket if checksums and time window match.
legal_jame: noted - I'll run privacy sign-off once lee ACKs.
ir-bot: Playbook: mark the SLE-EVID ticket as 'evidence-ready' only after both security and legal ACKs are present.
lee_ir: ACKed in ticket SLE-EVID-9921. checksums validated, window covers 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-14. go ahead pending legal final.
morgan_az: thanks team. closing thread after legal sign-off. :white_check_mark:
